description: The stargazers say Rich Per’s daughter will marry the miller’s baby, born at the mill just below his farm, so Per buys the child, seals him in a chest and pushes it out into the river. But it is a very good chest, and it doesn’t leak.
summary: Rich Per the Pedlar tries every trick to get rid of the miller’s boy who is fated to marry his daughter, and finally sends him to the Dragon of Deep-Ford.
